name: Wave Race 64 HD texture pack
summary: Reviewed Nano Banana 2 texture replacements with source-preserving fallbacks for rejected candidates.
Complete audited HUD font families, logos, course signage, buoy icons, power flags and result labels.
Eight user-selected dark-visor helmet portraits and the rank arrow at 8x native dimensions.
Four ramp-wood and four island-material refinements at 8x; world textures carry full mip chains.
32 craft side-panel replacements cover primary/opponent models and normal/alternate palettes. Other craft materials keep their earlier reviewed replacements.
